new_defects.what: pixel_order's match (byte+3 bits 4 and 6) is contradicted by EXP-0147's own committed dense M4 accept sets: each carrier accepts 32 values the match rejects (high nibbles 9 and b) and rejects 32 it admits
new_defects.status: REPORTED, NOT ACTED ON -- the pin is G17P (EXP-0162) and the refutation M4 (EXP-0147); needs its own G17P experiment

new_defects.what: five descriptors' HW-validated anchors do not tokenize: bf_add_dst, bf_fma_dst (DEF-0171-2, known), cvt_bf16, cvt_f2h_dst, hminmax (all three NEW). hminmax decodes at only 2 of 16 destination nibbles and not at the validated one
new_defects.status: REPORTED, NOT PATCHED -- it is a length-rule change in isadb.py, another owner's file, and would move decode for a wider family
